# Rank Max (rankmax)

> Open-source CLI tool and multi-agent optimization engine that audits websites for SEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), simulates AI citations, and generates production fix packs.

## Core Commands
- `npx rankmax scan <url>`: Audits 10 SEO/AEO/GEO signals and scores readiness from 0–100.
- `npx rankmax crawl <url>`: Deep-crawls sitemaps and internal links to find weak or broken pages.
- `npx rankmax simulate <url>`: Simulates ChatGPT/Perplexity passage extraction and calculates AI Citation Probability.
- `npx rankmax agent <url>`: Dispatches 4 sub-agents to auto-generate `robots.txt`, `llms.txt`, JSON-LD `@graph` schema, and Open Graph tags.
